acceptanceCriteria: Range impact over a .rb change in a Gemfile+spec repo lists bundle exec rspec, covered by a test
Go range plans byte-unchanged; NGI-V0 non-goal replaced by a numbered requirement
body: PR #1134 (V1-1796, NGI-V0-027) adds bundle exec rspec to path impact. On the #1130 fixture, corvint impact --base <sha> still returns verification [git diff --check] only, because rangeVerification (internal/contextindex/range_impact.go:746) builds a Go-only plan. NGI-V0-027 records this as a non-goal. Expected: committed-range impact on .rb changes names the same rspec command as path impact. Coordinate with V1-1794, which owns range_impact.go.
title: Range impact (--base) names no Ruby verification command: rangeVerification is Go-only (residual of PR #1134 / NGI-V0-027)
